title: Investigate a slim, fast native Mermaid viewer
body: Initial source investigation: docs/2026-09-22-native-mermaid-investigation.md. Recommend benchmarking mermaid-svg with the existing resvg/egui stack; compare mermaid-rs-renderer if fidelity fails. Font support needs explicit work. No performance or binary-size measurements yet. User priority: avoid bloat; keep an on-demand file viewer, and gate adoption on measured incremental size and terminal responsiveness.
